title: astragalus mancus
intro: Astragalus mancus, commonly known as the lesser milkvetch, is a perennial plant native to North America. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus mancus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus mancus include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
